what: In a horizontal row of cells (such as the seven services), the hovered cell widens to flex 3.4 and the others collapse to 1 (.7s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)). Collapsed cells show a grayscale image at .4 with only the name laid out vertically. The expanded cell’s image returns to full color, the vertical name vanishes at .2s, then after a .3s delay the title and description rise from 1rem below over .7s. On phones the cells stack vertically and only the tapped cell grows taller

options.[data-fx-part=item·media·side·body]: Cell · image behind the cell · vertical name when folded · text when unfolded
